cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI.
cells.note: Organic Law 53.25 and HACA decision 50-26 bind AI-generated electoral content, and the CNDP has the mission of ensuring AI processing of personal data complies with Law 09-08, which meets questions 2 and 3. The CNDP mission carries the authority rung, and no enforcement decision is held.
